nameOrigin.text: An 1835 Army expedition mapped the lake as Summit Lake; the name later changed to Divide Lake and finally Palmer Lake. General William J. Palmer bought the land that became the town.

timeline.text: General William J. Palmer started the Denver & Rio Grande Railroad, which stopped at the lake to take on water.
Dr. William Finley Thompson came to Colorado and soon platted the Town of Palmer Lake as a health and vacation resort.
Thompson built the Estemere mansion, and the Rocky Mountain Chautauqua began; it ran until 1910.
The Palmer Lake Star was built on Sundance Mountain.
